title: Croissant ML metadata + Datasheet emitter for cleaned outputs
context: A future-backlog task supporting the documentation-completeness metric: every delivered dataset should carry a Datasheet/metadata record describing the cleaning applied. This adds a Croissant ML v1.0 metadata + Datasheet emitter for cleaned outputs, reusable with the open-data-datasheets effort. Builds on the export/standards work.
objective: Implement a Croissant ML metadata + Datasheet emitter that attaches a standards-conformant metadata record and datasheet describing the cleaning applied to each cleaned output.
acceptanceCriteria: Emits Croissant ML v1.0 metadata for cleaned outputs
Generates a Datasheet describing the cleaning applied (rules fired, before/after error-rate, provenance)
Designed for reuse with the open-data-datasheets project
output: A PR adding a Croissant ML metadata + Datasheet emitter for cleaned outputs.
